comment: The fundamental frequency is the pitch knob plus the V/oct jack as an exponent of two times 16.35159783128741466737, the literal at Ad.cpp:270, which is C0. The knob runs -1 to 6, so seven octaves; the maker's manual says nine, which is the reach of the spectrum rather than of the knob. The CV scalings are at lines 177-184 and 257-258 and are all fractions of the knob travel, not volts per unit. The reset and clock jacks are plain level tests against 2.5V (lines 158 and 227), not Schmitt triggers, so a slow signal can retrigger them. The stereo mode in the menu is overridden to Mono whenever the right sum output is unpatched (lines 247-250). The panel prints 'root' over the third output while the maker's tooltip calls it 'fundamental'.
